records.name: Message Album
records.tagline: Save one iMessage conversation as a private offline album
records.description: A native Mac app that exports one Messages conversation at a time into a searchable, iMessage-style offline website with the photos, videos and voice notes stored on your Mac. Reads your library without changing it. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: LoupeKit
records.tagline: See what any page is built with and how much of it is AI
records.description: A developer's inspector for the page you already have open. It names the technologies behind it and shows the evidence for each, extracts the palette, fonts and assets, and scores how much of the page reads as raw AI output. It reads one tab, when you ask.

records.name: Screenify Studio
records.tagline: Polished product demos on Mac recorded by an AI agent
records.description: Screenify Studio is a Mac screen recorder that turns rough recordings into polished product demos — without the editing tax. Describe a demo in plain English and an AI drives a real browser to record it, then adds cinematic 3D camera moves, spotlights, and callouts. Prefer full control? A deep editor with manual zoom keyframes. Stage recordings in a photoreal 3D MacBook, iPhone, or iPad, add on-device AI captions, or drive it all from a CLI an agent like Claude Code can run. Free to start.

records.name: Evidence Core
records.tagline: Build live analytics with coding agents
records.description: Evidence Core is an open source framework for building business intelligence applications with coding agents. Build your entire business intelligence platform as a repo of files, and deploy it anywhere, for free. Metrics, dashboards, reports and themes are all specified in code which you can validate, preview and serve using the Evidence CLI.

records.name: macadress
records.tagline: MAC address intelligence for apps, networks and AI agents
records.description: Look beyond the vendor name. Understand MAC addresses with IEEE block data, device-category clues, privacy-randomization signals and plain-English reasoning. Use it through the free lookup, JSON API, bulk databases, log extractor, MCP or self-hosted deployment.

records.name: TaskShell 2.0
records.tagline: Agent-first task management for more agentic productivity
records.description: Manage your tasks together with your agents for complete agentic productivity. Ask to add a relevant todo as a task from your conversation mid-session, ask what's due for this week, what's most important, ask for help to plan your work, update tasks, bring up notes that are important to inject as context, and keep your agents in the loop across platforms. All through a simple but powerful MCP that syncs with all modern agents from Claude Code, to Cursor, to OpenCode, to OpenClaw, and more.

records.name: Basedash for Grok Bot
records.tagline: Company data answers, right inside Grok Bot
records.description: Basedash for Grok Bot sends questions to governed company data and brings the answer back into your agent. Open Plugins, add Basedash, sign in with OAuth, then ask “Which accounts drove this quarter’s NRR change?” or list the sources you can use. One hosted MCP, no API keys. Your existing Basedash workspace access controls still apply. Also available in Cursor.

records.name: Playcall
records.tagline: The open-source AI alternative to Gong
records.description: Playcall is the open-source alternative to Gong, built for AI-native GTM teams. Score every call against your playbook and the buyer context your rep was talking to. Works with MEDDPICC, BANT, SPIN, or upload your playbook and let AI generate the rubric. Get evidence-backed scores, missed moments, and outcome tracking. Every score comes with a coaching drill for the rep to run next. Self-hostable. No lock-in, no $30K/year contracts, or 10+ baked-in features your team never touches.

records.name: BaudBuddy
records.tagline: A native macOS serial terminal with a file server built in
records.description: A native macOS terminal for serial, Bluetooth LE, Telnet and RFC 2217 consoles — with a TFTP/HTTP/HTTPS/FTP/SFTP server built in for firmware. Adapters by name, real break signals, byte-exact logs. No account, no analytics, no cloud.

records.name: OpenComputer
records.tagline: Firebase for Agents
records.description: Introducing OpenComputer Deploy your agent as a function. Get a computer for it. - a real Linux machine per session - ffmpeg, chromium, git, install anything - durable: hibernate + resume - your keys never enter the runtime The cloud of the last decade was built for apps. The next one is for trillions of always on agents. OpenComputer is their home.

records.name: Mac mini
records.tagline: Now with M6 and M5 Pro chips
records.description: Mac mini now comes with M6 and M5 Pro, bringing faster performance, Apple Intelligence, Wi-Fi 7, and faster storage to Apple's compact 5-inch desktop. Built for coding, creating, and getting work done.

records.name: Warren
records.tagline: Infrastructure for coding-agent workloads
records.description: Warren runs agent harnesses as isolated, observable workloads on infrastructure you control. It owns the workspace, limits, live events, recovery, and Git delivery.

records.name: Tellie Prompter 1.5
records.tagline: The teleprompter that knows what you haven't said
records.description: Most teleprompters make you follow them. Tellie follows you. It listens to the words you actually say, so you can pause, skip, improvise, or go off script without losing your place. Now Tellie 1.5 knows what you haven’t said yet, too. It tracks your important points, warns when you’re running long, and debriefs your take. All in a 3 MB Mac app that runs locally, with no account and no telemetry. Free for 10 days and $10 off for ProductHunt with code PRODHUNT10

records.name: Termy
records.tagline: Learn languages from games, videos, and websites
records.description: Termy turns the games, videos, and websites you love into language practice. Press one shortcut and it finds the difficult words on your screen, explains them in context, and saves them with the exact moment you discovered them—without breaking your flow. Later, those moments become adaptive exercises built around your vocabulary. Works on Windows and macOS in 30 languages. Free to start.

records.name: Expertise AI
records.tagline: Turn your GTM skills into recurring revenue
records.description: Expertise AI is where GTM experts monetize their playbooks as protected Al skills. Each expert gets a storefront where businesses demo and install these skills on a subscription, and gets paid every time one runs.

records.name: PostHog Desktop
records.tagline: The product editor for product builders
records.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.

records.name: ChatCut Desktop
records.tagline: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
records.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

records.name: x1
records.tagline: Lovable for iPhone apps go from idea to App Store
records.description: X1 is an AI app builder that takes you from an idea to an iPhone app you can publish on the App Store. Instead of trying to generate the entire app from one prompt, X1 guides you step by step. It asks focused questions, designs each screen for you to review and edit, then builds the app in stages. Preview and test it on your iPhone as you go. When it’s ready, X1 prepares your App Store listing, screenshots, and submission. No coding required.

records.name: DeployHermes
records.tagline: Hire persistent Hermes agents with roles, memory + skills
records.description: Hire persistent Hermes AI bots with a role, model, memory and skills. One click to a private runtime — missions, integrations, and receipts on every run. Integrate this with your Claude Code, Codex, and let the agents manage your bots and then your work seamlessly.

records.name: Knack MCP Server
records.tagline: The HIPAA-compliant backend for AI builders
records.description: AI tools like Lovable, Base44, or Claude Code can get a healthcare app up and running quickly. The backend is where healthcare gets complicated. Once PHI is involved, you need compliant data storage, record retention, and a signed BAA. Knack Health is the HIPAA-compliant backend built for healthcare apps. Connect your AI frontend and get 700+ integrations, a signed BAA, and unlimited users starting at $499. We handle the compliance layer, so you can go from prototype to production.

records.name: ReWeaver AI DriftDetector
records.tagline: Drift score for any GitHub repo
records.description: The code works. That was never the question. Paste any public GitHub repo and get its Production Drift Ratio (PDR) in seconds: one number for how far it sits from production-ready, plus a drift history where every point is a real scan, not an estimate. No signup, nothing to install. Deterministic rules, no LLM in the loop, no tokens burned. Nine dimensions, every finding traced to a file and a line. Try it on something vibe-coded and watch the score climb. From the team at ReWeaver AI.

records.name: Lore Machine
records.tagline: Substack For World Builders
records.description: There's a new creator in town: The World Builder. Armed with the most advanced visualization technology known to man, World Builders conjure multimedia universes one serialized story at a time. But Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube weren't built to hold them. On Lore Machine, World Builders turn text into scrollable multimedia adventures called LORE, then serialize LOREs into a World with solid state characters, canon and narrative physics. Today, they can sell tickets to their World.

records.name: MCP-Builder.ai
records.tagline: The fastest way to connect your data with your AI Tools.
records.description: Build a hosted and secured MCP Server in minutes. Think of MCP-Builder.ai as Lovable for MCP connectors. Describe what you want to connect and it builds, hosts and secures your MCP Server for you. No deployment, infrastructure or security setup needed. Connect: • Databases • APIs • 3rd party apps • Files • And more Get your MCP URL, add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP compatible client and start using it.

records.name: ify
records.tagline: Resolution AI that works on top of your existing helpdesk
records.description: Most AI support tools ask you to rip out your helpdesk first. Ify works on top of Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce, or HubSpot and gets to work across email, chat, WhatsApp, Slack, and more. The part that usually stalls an AI support rollout is "our docs aren't good enough." Ify solves that by building its own knowledge base: it scrapes your site and docs, generates SOPs from release notes and past ticket resolutions. Built for support teams who want something live now.

records.name: Arena Agent Mode with GitHub
records.tagline: Get real work done, moving from idea to shipping in minutes
records.description: For a coding agent to be truly useful, it needs to live where the work is: on GitHub. By integrating directly with GitHub and reusing the underlying infrastructure of Agent Mode, we’ve created a seamless experience that allows you to connect a repo, complete a coding task, and push the results—all without leaving your browser.

records.name: EasySwitch
records.tagline: One mouse, keyboard and second screen for all your computers
records.description: Existing tools make you choose. Software KVMs (Synergy, Deskflow, Mouse Without Borders) share your mouse and keyboard but carry no video. Second-screen apps (Duet, spacedesk, Luna) turn a spare machine into a monitor but share no input. EasySwitch does both: slide your cursor across computers, type and paste anywhere, drag files, and extend your desktop onto the machine next to you. Encryption is free for everyone, not an upsell. Wayland works. Native Rust, no Electron - 19 MB of RAM idle.

records.name: choclift for iPad
records.tagline: A touch-bar to control your Mac from your iPad
records.description: choclift now turns your iPad into a beautifully simple touch companion for your Mac...and it feels like pure magic. Launch apps, run Apple Shortcuts, open websites, and add your favorite emojis to any text with a single tap, all from one resizable view. Connect multiple devices at once, tap an empty tile to add whatever is open on your Mac, and use swipe gestures for quick actions. Now available for free on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro in eight languages.

records.name: HEVN U.S.
records.tagline: Hold USD and pay globally through U.S. sponsor banks
records.description: HEVN U.S. Accounts give eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD banking through U.S. sponsor banks. Receive USD via Fedwire, hold USD, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported SWIFT payments from one platform. Built for importers, exporters, commodity traders, manufacturers, and other global businesses whose shipments and operations cannot wait for slow payment chains.

records.name: Know When Your Track Is Finished
records.tagline: Songwriting, production, mix and mastering steps
records.description: A music production tracker and project management app for producers: songwriting, production, mixing and mastering broken into steps you check off, so you always know how close your track is to done. Free to start, runs in your browser.

records.name: Gramit
records.tagline: Diagrams that nest, so complexity stays readable
records.description: Every diagram breaks as the system grows. You get one unreadable canvas or ten disconnected files. In Gramit, any node can contain its own diagram, so you zoom from context to detail without losing the thread. Built for engineers documenting real architectures.

records.name: GlassDesk Pro
records.tagline: Sleek translucent desktop organizer for Windows 11
records.description: GlassDesk Pro is a modern, lightweight desktop organizer for Windows 11 & 10. Organize shortcuts into sleek translucent Acrylic & Mica glass containers. Highlights: • 🪟 Fluent Design with real-time blur & custom colors • 👁️ Double-click empty desktop to hide/reveal panels • 📂 Live Folder Portals without duplicating files • ⚡ Ultra-low RAM (~50-135 MB) • 📑 Multi-page desktop layouts • 💰 No subscriptions: $9.99 lifetime license (2 PCs) with a 15-day free trial on Microsoft Store.

records.name: GitHub Avatar Art
records.tagline: Change The Look of Your Github
records.description: 🎨 GitHub Avatar Art — Turn Your GitHub Avatar Into Code Art Tests Next.js TypeScript License A developer identity tool that fetches any public GitHub profile avatar and transforms it into stunning, algorithmic code art for your GitHub profile README. No login or OAuth required. 100% Deterministic — the same profile + style + params + seed always yields the exact same byte-identical artwork and permanent URL.

records.name: VaultGuard
records.tagline: Per-file permissions for your AI knowledge-base in Obsidian
records.description: Obsidian is the best thinking and knowledge-base tool ever built for one person. VaultGuard makes it work for a team. It adds encrypted sync, per-file permissions, share-links, AI chat, guest access and audit logs to the vault you already have — no migration, no new app to learn. You write exactly as you do today; VaultGuard protects who can view and work with the files. Point Claude or GPT at the vault and the AI inherits the same permissions your people do. Free if you self-host.

records.name: Five Cents · Personalized AI podcasts
records.tagline: Turn any question into a five-minute podcast
records.description: The future of content is generated and personalized. Five Cents turns any question into a five-minute podcast. Ask what you want to understand, listen instead of reading, and refine future episodes with feedback about your interests, background, or preferred level of detail. It also includes current-news podcasts and audio travel guides.

records.name: SynaBot AI
records.tagline: The AI hub built for small business.
records.description: SynaBot.ai is a curated hub of AI assistants, tools, prompts, and guides built specifically for small businesses — helping you find the right AI for marketing, sales, legal, ops, and more, without wading through endless listicles and forum threads.

records.name: Launch
records.tagline: A place for your scripts
records.description: Launch is a Mac application that runs built-in and custom JavaScript files. Your scripts live in ~/Launch (or another folder if you prefer) and you can connect to any Git backend to sync them. You can `cd` to change the active directory and some scripts will run in that directory (e.g. to copy or delete certain files) while others run anywhere (e.g. to open an app). You can think of it as a launcher with some shell functionality, or an extensible command line with quick launch and autocomplete.

records.name: CryptoWorld News
records.tagline: Whale flows, signals & on-chain data on one screen
records.description: Everything happening in crypto on one screen. Whale movements across 18 exchanges and 72 chains with wallet labelling and association, live derivatives, exchange net-flows, stablecoin supply and ETF custody. A confluence engine scores 383 coins across 10 signals every few minutes, plus directional signals, in-house charting, news from 158 sources, a global map and per-coin alerts. For active retail traders. £14.99/mo founding price, 7-day trial, no card.

records.name: ID8S GEO IQ
records.tagline: Improve your AI Search Visibility. Get cited by AI.
records.description: ID8S is a software company building tools for the AI search era. Its product, GEO IQ, is the AI Search Visibility Platform: it scores any page on whether AI answer engines can find, understand, and cite its content, then returns recommendations ranked by score improvement and tracks whether they worked. Search is splitting in two, and a page that is not structured for AI answers can be absent from them no matter how it performs in classic organic search.

records.name: Sherlock - AI Face Search
records.tagline: Sherlock: AI face search for finding similar face matches.
records.description: Sherlock - AI Face Search: Reverse face search, people finder, and photo verifier tools in one app! Upload a photo or link to find visually similar faces, public photos, and web matches instantly. Sherlock uses smart AI visual matching to compare face scores, preview images, and link to public profiles. Keep your searches safe and private with all search history saved locally on your device. Download Sherlock today to search and verify visual matches in seconds!

records.name: Polahari - Daily Checklist Templates
records.tagline: Templates that adapt to any day — your week, your rules
records.description: Most checklist apps give you one static list — same for Monday and Saturday, retyped daily. Polahari flips that. Build reusable templates ("Work Day," "Weekend," whatever fits), assign them to any weekday, and let your week run itself. Add one-off tasks for random stuff. Track streaks without guilt — slip on a habit, it's logged, not punished. Free forever, up to 5 templates. No ads, no tracking.

records.name: CallXcel
records.tagline: Automate every call. Capture every lead. 24/7.
records.description: CallXcel is an AI-powered voice automation platform that helps businesses automate inbound and outbound calls, qualify leads, book appointments, route conversations, and manage customer interactions 24/7. With human-like AI voice agents, intelligent call routing, CRM integrations, multilingual support, real-time scheduling, and analytics, CallXcel helps sales, support, and operations teams reduce missed opportunities, improve response times, and scale customer communication.

records.name: NFTswork-NFT Generator
records.tagline: Create NFT collections from layers—no code, no uploads.
records.description: NFT Generator is a privacy-first, no-code studio for creating NFT collections.Import your layers and traits, set rarity weights, preview random combinations, and export thousands of images with mint-ready metadata in a single ZIP file.Everything runs directly in your browser, so your artwork stays on your device. No coding, no complex setup, and no need to outsource your collection generation workflow. Perfect for NFT artists, creators, communities, and Web3 teams launching their next collection

records.name: M-block
records.tagline: Lightweight, high-performance Manifest V3 ad blocker
records.description: Introducing m-block 1.0. The next step for ad blocking on Manifest V3. Performance Benchmarks m-block: 99% (504/507 blocked) uBlock Origin Lite: 70% (365/507) AdBlock: 40% (182/507) Key Features 182K+ domains covered across 59,000 rules YouTube ad optimization and popup suppression Zero telemetry and zero data collection Available for Chrome & Firefox.

records.name: GlobalGPT
records.tagline: GPT, Claude, Gemini & every top AI — one subscription

GlobalGPT gives you every top model in one account: Chat: GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek Image: Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Ideogram Video: Seedance, Sora 2, Veo, Kling Localized in 9 languages. Advanced AI shouldn't be a privilege reserved for those who can afford the full stack — for students, solo creators, or anyone building next.

records.name: Telegram
records.tagline: VidMachineBot — type a topic, get video
records.description: VidMachineBot turns any topic into a ready-to-post video automatically. It writes the script, records a voiceover, pulls matching footage, adds subtitles — done. Add your own images or video clips, or write your own script — it reads it word-for-word. Real photos for real subjects: a Rolex video shows actual Rolexes, not stock. Built for real estate agents, faceless YouTube creators, daily content teams. Free local AI — no per-video cost, no subscription. Try it free: t.me/vidmachinebot

records.name: Solocash
records.tagline: Stream digital value globally in 1 minute. flat fee. 1-click
records.description: Moving value globally shouldn’t mean losing 3-6% to hidden FX spreads, waiting days for legacy banks, or standing in line. Solo Cash’s non-custodial web app powered by DirectSync™ and SoloStream™ bypasses old platforms. Our design abstracts blockchain mechanics for a 1-click experience. • Flat-Fee: Transparent access starting at 5.99 USDC for up to 400 USDC • 1–2 Min Execution: Rapid routing from point A to B via email address • Settlement: 1-click into GCash, Maya, or local bank accounts.

records.name: Folio V1
records.tagline: Local-first novel writing, now on every desktop
records.description: Folio is a free, local-first desktop writing studio for novelists. Draft and organize Markdown chapters, plan beats and story threads, build a Codex, track revisions and snapshots, and export to PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown, or TXT. Muse provides manuscript-aware AI through fully local Gemma or your own cloud API keys - while your book remains on your disk. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

records.name: PostDovo
records.tagline: Create & schedule a month of social content in minutes
records.description: PostDovo is an AI-powered social media automation platform that turns your website, product URL, or topic into ready-to-publish content for multiple social platforms. It creates captions, visuals, hashtags, and platform-specific posts, then lets you review, edit, schedule, and publish everything from one dashboard. Create and schedule a month of social content in minutes instead of spending hours doing it manually.

records.name: TwiceOver
records.tagline: A second look at the positions you already hold.
records.description: Connect your brokerage read-only and the read runs on the positions you actually hold — your rules, your horizons. Or hand it any US-listed ticker: no account, no connection. Either way it weighs price and levels, filings-grade fundamentals, sector and macro regime into one synthesized read — and names the layers it didn't weigh instead of papering over them. Depth, never a verdict. US at launch.

records.tagline: AI Local Radar Lead Scanner & B2B Script Generator
records.description: ContextScale maps business locations via an Overpass Radar, while Derrick AI enriches data & outputs email scripts. 🚨 72-HOUR FREE ACCESS: Our gateway is in Test Mode. Access is 100% open to the community for 72 hours! Bypass our payment wall for $0 by using any standard developer test card at checkout. ⚠️ NOTE: In 72 hours we switch to Live Mode, swapping keys and running a master session purge to clear test data. Grab your free agency leads & export your CSV files now!

records.description: Every platform sells the first meeting. We built the second one. OpenCT is the retention layer for offline communities. Discover nearby gatherings, reserve your seat, connect with people before you arrive, continue conversations after the gathering, and return together. We help organisers turn one-time attendees into returning members and gatherings into lasting communities. Discover → Join → Meet → Connect → Community Because community begins after the event.

records.description: MyCloudSchool is a modern, multi-tenant SaaS platform built to simplify school management. records.name: SectionVault
records.tagline: Pre-built Elementor sections. Copy, paste, and customize.
records.description: SectionVault is an Elementor component library with 400+ stunning pre-built sections you copy from the site and paste straight into the editor. No plugin to install, no template kit to import. SectionVault contains all the components you need: heroes, pricing tables, FAQs, testimonials, feature grids, team sections, logo strips, CTAs, contact forms, and full ecommerce sections including product grids, product detail layouts, cart and checkout pages.

records.name: GeminiOmni
records.tagline: AI video, images, music and PDF chat in one studio
records.description: GeminiOmni brings AI video, image generation and editing, music generation, and long-document PDF chat into one browser studio. Start from a prompt or reference image, choose the tool and model that fits the job, and spend from one shared credit balance without managing separate provider accounts. Built for creators moving across formats in one project. PDF chat is free for documents under 200 pages; video and media tools use credit packs or subscriptions.

records.name: QuoteGlide
records.tagline: Create quotes and automate follow-ups for small businesses
records.description: QuoteGlide is a lightweight quote workflow for trades and small service businesses. Turn rough job notes into a professional quote with AI, send it as a branded, secure page, and see when your customer opens it. Customers can accept, decline, ask a question, or request a change without creating an account. If they stay quiet, QuoteGlide sends polite reminders on days 3, 7, and 14, then stops the moment they respond. No spreadsheets, awkward chasing, or heavyweight CRM.

records.name: Snake Apple
records.tagline: Play 30 clever snake puzzles free in your browser
records.description: Snake Apple is a free browser puzzle game with no download or timer. Eat the apple, use the worm's growing body to bridge gaps and avoid hazards, then reach the portal. Play all 30 original levels and open a dedicated video walkthrough whenever you get stuck.

records.name: ZakatBooks

records.description: Deep Enrich runs your list through multiple data vendors in a waterfall enrichment, then verifies every email and validates every phone. Competitive find rates and bounce rates worldwide, all in one subscription. Chrome extension, spreadsheet upload, and API included.

records.name: TermAI

records.description: TermAI is a mobile SSH/SFTP client for iOS & Android. Its AI assistant suggests commands you confirm before running (not an agent that runs things on its own), and built-in Tailscale reaches your private servers without a second VPN app — so you can run and troubleshoot production servers right from your phone. Free tier: unlimited SSH/SFTP + 5 AI actions a day.

Paste any of them and get the transcript: captions if they exist, AI if they don't. Export TXT, SRT or VTT, or upload a file straight from your machine. No extension. 2 free credits, no card.

records.name: Gyre
records.tagline: Track your lifts with a muscle heatmap and AI analysis
records.description: Gyre is a free workout tracker that goes beyond sets and reps. It colors a real muscle map based on what you've actually trained recently (primary + secondary muscles), not a generic diagram. It auto-detects PRs and estimates your 1RM per exercise, and a weekly AI analysis reasons over your real training data (RIR/RPE trend, volume per muscle group, bodyweight trend) instead of giving generic advice. Routines remember your last weights and reps so you can start a session with one tap.

records.name: Winstrol (Stanozolol) 25mg x 50 Capsules
records.tagline: Winstrol 25mg x 50 Capsules – Stanozolol Product Information
records.description: Winstrol (Stanozolol) 25mg x 50 Capsules is an oral product listed on the Simply Steroids website. The page identifies stanozolol, also known as Winstrol or Winny, and states that each pack contains 50 capsules at 25mg. The listing categorizes it among oral products and provides general bodybuilding-related information. Stanozolol is an anabolic steroid with health risks and should only be used under appropriate medical supervision and in accordance with applicable laws and prescribing guidance.

records.name: Bookmark Preview Sidebar
records.tagline: Hover to preview and manage your Chrome bookmarks instantly
records.description: Stop opening endless tabs just to see your bookmarked pages.  Bookmark Preview Sidebar upgrades Chrome with a smart sidebar. Simply hover over any bookmark to see a real-time preview window instantly.  ✨ Features: • Hover to Preview: See page contents in a popup without clicking. • Smart UI: Closes automatically when your mouse leaves. • Easy Clean-up: Delete bookmarks with a trash icon.  Perfect for organizing your bookmarks efficiently!

records.name: SIZZAPP nova + Smart Key Fob
records.tagline: Smart GPS security with no monthly subscription fees
records.description: SIZZAPP nova pairs a compact, ultra-low-power GPS tracker with a Smart Key Fob that automatically controls vehicle security as you approach or leave. It provides real-time worldwide tracking, movement alerts, geofences and trip history through the SIZZAPP app. Unlike subscription-based trackers, the bundle includes lifetime app access, SIM and mobile data with no monthly fees. Built for motorcycles, cars and other vehicles, it is now live from €285.

records.name: Sanbi.ai
records.tagline: Don't just track AI citations, act on them.
records.description: Don't just track AI citations, act on them. Sanbi.ai is a Generative Engine Optimization platform that monitors your brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. Track your AI Visibility Score, map exact citation sources, and analyze your Share of Voice against competitors. We go beyond reporting to help you identify citation gaps and optimize your content. Own your category and become the brand AI recommends as search shifts from links to answers.

records.name: CodeVerse
records.tagline: A collaborative browser IDE with evidence for every change
records.description: CodeVerse is an open-source collaborative browser IDE for building with humans and AI. It combines CRDT editing, Redis-backed distributed sessions, isolated execution, AI-assisted review, and replayable EvidenceOS records that explain what changed, why it changed, and how to recover. The v1.1 launch adds a reproducible 76-second tour, a public contributor roadmap, GHCR images, and the first merged external accessibility contribution.

records.name: HireBots
records.tagline: Hire AI agents for any digital task
records.description: HireBots is a marketplace where you post a mission — research, code conversion, data scraping, content creation — and specialized AI bots submit competitive bids with milestones, timelines, and pricing. Describe your problem in plain language. Our AI advisor scopes it into a concrete project. Compare bids, award the best one, track delivery through milestones, and pay with escrow protection — released only when you approve. 85+ missions completed. 25+ providers. 28+ bots. Live since July 2026.

records.name: Rent Me Help
records.tagline: Connect with trusted helpers to get things done
records.description: RentMeHelp connects people who need help with vetted Helpers — local, remote, or live video — all in one place. Post any Work or Life Goal (business support, brand growth, pet care, property, wellness) and get matched, instead of juggling separate apps per task. What's different: goal-based posting with clear deliverables, built-in paid video sessions, background-checked Helpers, secure payments, and public reputation scores — all with transparent, upfront platform fees.

records.name: Tech AI Wire
records.tagline: Daily AI & dev-tools tech news for people who ship code
records.description: Tech AI Wire is a daily news site about AI and developer tools, written for the people who use the thing, not the people funding it. What makes it different: - Every story ends with "What this means for developers" - the takeaway most coverage skips - At least two independent, named sources per story, all linked - Prices, dates and benchmarks attributed in the text; rumors labeled as rumors - Published in six languages - No paywall, no filler - on a thin news day we publish fewer stories

records.name: Rank Your Agent
records.tagline: Where AI agents compete, rank, and prove themselves.
records.description: Key features that make it stand out: Global AI-agent leaderboard — see which agents are ranking at the top. Public rankings and visibility — give AI-agent creators a way to showcase their work. Head-to-head competition — agents compete for position rather than simply being listed. Simple submission flow — creators can quickly put their agent on the leaderboard. Built for discovery — users can discover interesting AI agents through rankings instead of searching through endless directories.

records.name: RYNTO
records.tagline: The operating system for modern property management
records.description: RYNTO goes beyond traditional property management software. It connects property managers, owners, guests, bookings, operations and service providers in one platform. Owner and Guest Portals provide dedicated experiences, while built-in analytics track revenue, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR. Next, the RYNTO Service Marketplace will connect properties with local cleaning, maintenance and other service providers.

records.name: PostHog Desktop
records.tagline: The product editor for product builders
records.description: A multiplayer workspace for you, your team, and your agents – with your product data as context, and PostHog tools to ship and measure. Build and edit your product | Run a fleet of agents | Turn product signals into PRs.

records.name: Safe Little Faces
records.tagline: Blur kids' faces before sharing family photos
records.description: Safe Little Faces helps parents and caregivers prepare family photos for sharing without sending them to a server. Pick the faces you want to protect, then use an opaque cover, mosaic, emoji, or soft blur. Face detection and editing happen on your iPhone. Exports are newly encoded without the source photo's location, capture date, camera, lens, or device metadata. There is no account, photo upload, advertising, tracking, or in-app analytics. Originals are never changed.

records.name: shopmap
records.tagline: Discover, manage, and grow local shops on an interactive map
records.description: ShopMap is a smart location-based platform that connects customers with local businesses through an interactive map. Users can discover nearby shops, explore detailed business profiles, and find services faster. Business owners get a dedicated dashboard to manage their shop information, products, and online presence with powerful customization options. Unlike traditional directories, ShopMap combines maps, local search, and business management tools into one complete ecosystem.

records.name: x1
records.tagline: Lovable for iPhone apps go from idea to App Store
records.description: X1 is an AI app builder that takes you from an idea to an iPhone app you can publish on the App Store. Instead of trying to generate the entire app from one prompt, X1 guides you step by step. It asks focused questions, designs each screen for you to review and edit, then builds the app in stages. Preview and test it on your iPhone as you go. When it’s ready, X1 prepares your App Store listing, screenshots, and submission. No coding required.

records.name: ChatCut Desktop
records.tagline: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
records.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.

records.name: Joblira
records.tagline: Find work. Find talent. Build opportunities.
records.description: Joblira is a verified work and opportunity platform built for the way people actually work in Nigeria. Instead of focusing only on traditional jobs, Joblira connects businesses and individuals with people who can complete specific tasks, whether remote, hybrid, or physical. Earners can discover relevant opportunities, while businesses can find trusted talent, assign tasks, and manage payments through a simpler workflow.

records.name: ify
records.tagline: Resolution AI that works on top of your existing helpdesk
records.description: Most AI support tools ask you to rip out your helpdesk first. Ify works on top of Freshdesk, Zendesk, Salesforce, or HubSpot and gets to work across email, chat, WhatsApp, Slack, and more. The part that usually stalls an AI support rollout is "our docs aren't good enough." Ify solves that by building its own knowledge base: it scrapes your site and docs, generates SOPs from release notes and past ticket resolutions. Built for support teams who want something live now.

records.name: PIC Pro
records.tagline: Logbook, checklists, maintenance and reports for Part 107
records.description: PIC Pro is a flight operations app for solo and small-team FAA Part 107 commercial drone operators. More than a logbook: log flights, run pre-flight and emergency checklists, keep a maintenance log per aircraft, manage batteries and fleet, track Part 107 recurrency, mark up job sites with annotated maps and photos, hold client records, and export client-ready PDF and CSV reports from your phone in the field. Offline-capable PWA, no app store, one flat plan with every feature. Not a photo editor.

records.name: NobleJackal GEO Reference System
records.tagline: Four open GEO works, six languages, auditable records
records.description: An open-access reference system for examining how organisations are represented in generative search and answer systems. It connects four independently published works: the NobleJackal GEO Framework, 99 Errors in GEO, the NOMOS GEO Audit Protocol and NOMOS GEO-QA. Together they provide 24 language editions, DOI records and machine-readable assets for inspection. This is a founder-proposed research framework, not an adopted standard, certification scheme or guarantee of AI visibility.

records.name: Orkas
records.tagline: Your professional AI team for scaling your business
records.description: Orkas is an open-source AI team for indie builders, one-person businesses, and small teams — built to help you scale your business. Brief one Commander; specialist agents split the job and deliver: marketing videos, websites, SEO/GEO, data analysis, and anything else you'd hire for. Start with free credits on our hosted models, or bring your own key and keep everything on your machine. Plugs into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, any MCP server, your data sources. MIT-licensed. macOS + Windows.

records.name: Ace the Test
records.tagline: Turn any PDF or photo of your notes into a practice test.
records.description: Ace the Test turns your own study material into a practice exam. Upload a PDF, a photo of your handwritten notes, or plain text, and Google Gemini writes 5–50 multiple-choice and true/false questions — each with an explanation — in about 30 seconds. Answer them, get instant feedback, and watch your accuracy and weak topics build up across sessions. Eight interface languages, and questions come back in the language you uploaded. Free plan, no credit card. Premium is $14.99/month.

records.name: Context Goblin
records.tagline: Code review that knows what your PR breaks in other repos
records.description: Context Goblin reviews pull requests. Register a second repo and it maps how your services are wired together, so the reviewer sees everything downstream that has an opinion about the change. You pick the reviewers with customizable subagents, prompts and MCPs. Install the GitHub App and your next PR gets reviewed. Free and instant for the first signed-up teams.

records.name: Expertise AI
records.tagline: Turn your GTM skills into recurring revenue
records.description: Expertise AI is where GTM experts monetize their playbooks as protected Al skills. Each expert gets a storefront where businesses demo and install these skills on a subscription, and gets paid every time one runs.

records.name: Termy
records.tagline: Learn languages from games, videos, and websites
records.description: Termy turns the games, videos, and websites you love into language practice. Press one shortcut and it finds the difficult words on your screen, explains them in context, and saves them with the exact moment you discovered them—without breaking your flow. Later, those moments become adaptive exercises built around your vocabulary. Works on Windows and macOS in 30 languages. Free to start.

records.name: NextCall
records.tagline: Call the next one!
records.description: Modern, browser-based queue management system for banks, clinics, government offices, retail stores, and service centers. Multi-tenant branch management with configurable services, windows, and staff across Basic/Pro/Enterprise plans Real-time WebSocket engine powers live display boards with flash animations, bell alerts, and voice announcements Public self-service kiosk with spam protection, thermal receipt printing, and role-based portals for users.

records.name: GM Calculator
records.tagline: 41 free calculators. No sign-up. No ads. Just results.
records.description: GM Calculator is a free, privacy-first collection of 41 online calculators for marketing, finance, health, and math. • Instant results (no page reload) • No sign-up, no ads, no tracking • Tools include ROAS, Compound Interest, BMR, TDEE, Percentage, GPA, Margin & more • Clean, fast, and works perfectly on mobile Whether you're a marketer optimizing ads, planning investments, tracking fitness goals, or solving math problems — get accurate answers in seconds.

records.name: Tiune - For Windows & MacOS
records.tagline: Writes what you meant not what you said. Now on Windows.
records.description: Tiune turns speech into clean, finished text in any field, macOS and Windows. Engine built in: offline from first launch, no download, no account, your voice never leaves the machine. Text lands punctuated, capitalised and free of "um" and "you know", not a raw transcript. Our first Windows release, and the first to write what you meant: "six, no, maybe five, say five" becomes "let's meet at five". Paid handles: Multilingual mid-sentence. Local stays free: no subscription, no word limits.

records.name: Ocherfort
records.tagline: Ship secure code with evidence, not guesswork
records.description: Ocherfort scans repositories, maps findings to standards, evaluates ship/no-ship gates, and uses AI only to explain evidence. Ocherfort is a local-first security CLI for repositories. It scans code, workflows, release pipelines, and agent configs, maps findings to standards like CWE, OWASP, and NIST, and answers the question teams actually care about.It also includes evidence-based AI for explanation and prioritization, without letting AI invent findings or override policy. Join the beta.

records.name: PageLantern
records.tagline: Website, API and uptime monitoring for small teams
records.description: PageLantern gives small operating teams one place to monitor websites, APIs, SSL certificates, domains, DNS, TCP services, and cron jobs. Failures become incidents, alerts go to the channels your team already uses, and hosted status pages keep customers informed. API assertions, OpenAPI/Postman imports, and browser checks go beyond basic uptime—without the complexity of a full observability suite. Start free, no credit card.

records.name: Slides Focus Organize 2.0
records.tagline: Modern AI Carousel & Slide Maker for LinkedIn & Instagram
records.description: Turn raw text into studio-grade carousels and slide decks in seconds. Built for creators, founders, and marketers who need high-retention visual content without spending hours in Figma or Canva. What’s new in 2.0: • Multi-format engine (4:5 LinkedIn, 1:1 Square, 9:16 Stories, 4:3) • Context-aware stock photo search & precision smart crop • Real-time visual editor with curated minimalist palettes • Vector-sharp HD exports in PDF and PNG • Public editable links for 1-click sharing

records.name: AetherLAM
records.tagline: Un-sandboxed Large Action Model & Local OS AI Agent Cockpit
records.description: Discover AetherLAM, the breakthrough Large Action Model AI built to bypass web sandboxes. Run un-sandboxed native operating system automations, custom document synthesis, and multi-device wireless subnet diagnostics on total autopilot through AetherLAM's global cockpit over globalintelpro.com.

records.name: The Golden Ticket
records.tagline: Our resumes beat A.T.S. filters to a pulp. Executive-grade.
records.description: Here's the reality: ~75% of resumes get auto-rejected by ATS before humans see them. Yours will be in a trash folder too, unless you fix it. Our resumes pass ATS like a VIP through security. The Golden Ticket transforms your messy career history into an executive-grade resume: Oxford-level vocabulary, polished golden formatting, ATS-proof. 120 seconds flat. Go land the interview and do something with your life. Check it out and land an interview, or skip and stay unemployed. Would be a shame.

records.name: HEVN U.S.
records.tagline: Hold USD and pay globally through U.S. sponsor banks
records.description: HEVN U.S. Accounts give eligible companies in 100+ countries access to USD banking through U.S. sponsor banks. Receive USD via Fedwire, hold USD, pay U.S. counterparties locally, and settle supported SWIFT payments from one platform. Built for importers, exporters, commodity traders, manufacturers, and other global businesses whose shipments and operations cannot wait for slow payment chains.

records.name: Arena Agent Mode with GitHub
records.tagline: Get real work done, moving from idea to shipping in minutes
records.description: For a coding agent to be truly useful, it needs to live where the work is: on GitHub. By integrating directly with GitHub and reusing the underlying infrastructure of Agent Mode, we’ve created a seamless experience that allows you to connect a repo, complete a coding task, and push the results—all without leaving your browser.

records.name: Monolith Lite
records.tagline: Free minimalist Notion workspace for freelancers
records.description: Most people don’t fail because they lack ideas — they fail because everything is scattered. Monolith Lite fixes that in 15 minutes. It turns chaos into a clear, focused Notion system with 5 core productivity modules (Projects & Tasks, Task Manager, Idea Incubator, Knowledge Base, Resources). Handcrafted for Notion Dark Mode and optimized for daily execution. 100% Free!

records.name: Growfile.app
records.tagline: Build your profile once. Get tailored CVs for every job.
records.description: Most resume tools make you start from scratch every time. Growfile works differently. You build your professional profile once: experience, skills, education. Then, for each job you apply to, Growfile analyzes the job description and generates a tailored, ATS-optimized CV and cover letter that surfaces what actually matters for that specific role. No more copy-pasting old files. No more generic cover letters. Currently in early access. We'd love your feedback.

records.name: MCP-Builder.ai
records.tagline: The fastest way to connect your data with your AI Tools.
records.description: Build a hosted and secured MCP Server in minutes. Think of MCP-Builder.ai as Lovable for MCP connectors. Describe what you want to connect and it builds, hosts and secures your MCP Server for you. No deployment, infrastructure or security setup needed. Connect: • Databases • APIs • 3rd party apps • Files • And more Get your MCP URL, add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP compatible client and start using it.

records.name: Tellie Prompter 1.5
records.tagline: The teleprompter that knows what you haven't said
records.description: Most teleprompters make you follow them. Tellie follows you. It listens to the words you actually say, so you can pause, skip, improvise, or go off script without losing your place. Now Tellie 1.5 knows what you haven’t said yet, too. It tracks your important points, warns when you’re running long, and debriefs your take. All in a 3 MB Mac app that runs locally, with no account and no telemetry. Free for 10 days and $10 off for ProductHunt with code PRODHUNT10

records.name: Knack MCP Server
records.tagline: The HIPAA-compliant backend for AI builders
records.description: AI tools like Lovable, Base44, or Claude Code can get a healthcare app up and running quickly. The backend is where healthcare gets complicated. Once PHI is involved, you need compliant data storage, record retention, and a signed BAA. Knack Health is the HIPAA-compliant backend built for healthcare apps. Connect your AI frontend and get 700+ integrations, a signed BAA, and unlimited users starting at $499. We handle the compliance layer, so you can go from prototype to production.

records.name: choclift for iPad
records.tagline: A touch-bar to control your Mac from your iPad
records.description: choclift now turns your iPad into a beautifully simple touch companion for your Mac...and it feels like pure magic. Launch apps, run Apple Shortcuts, open websites, and add your favorite emojis to any text with a single tap, all from one resizable view. Connect multiple devices at once, tap an empty tile to add whatever is open on your Mac, and use swipe gestures for quick actions. Now available for free on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro in eight languages.

records.name: Lore Machine
records.tagline: Substack For World Builders
records.description: There's a new creator in town: The World Builder. Armed with the most advanced visualization technology known to man, World Builders conjure multimedia universes one serialized story at a time. But Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube weren't built to hold them. On Lore Machine, World Builders turn text into scrollable multimedia adventures called LORE, then serialize LOREs into a World with solid state characters, canon and narrative physics. Today, they can sell tickets to their World.

records.name: Angza
records.tagline: AI Contract Auditor for Legal Teams & Businesses
records.description: Most contracts contain hidden risks — unbalanced liability caps, one‑sided clauses, and vague payment terms. Lawyers spend hours reviewing, and startups can't afford in‑house counsel. Angza is an AI auditor that scans PDFs, Word, Excel, and TXT files to surface risk scores, key terms, red flags, and recommendations — in under 2 minutes. 100+ document types, 99.2% accuracy, zero data retention, PDF/Excel/JSON exports. Free to try. Built by Clovis Odhiambo.

records.name: ReWeaver AI DriftDetector
records.tagline: Drift score for any GitHub repo
records.description: The code works. That was never the question. Paste any public GitHub repo and get its Production Drift Ratio (PDR) in seconds: one number for how far it sits from production-ready, plus a drift history where every point is a real scan, not an estimate. No signup, nothing to install. Deterministic rules, no LLM in the loop, no tokens burned. Nine dimensions, every finding traced to a file and a line. Try it on something vibe-coded and watch the score climb. From the team at ReWeaver AI.

records.name: DeployHermes
records.tagline: Hire persistent Hermes agents with roles, memory + skills
records.description: Hire persistent Hermes AI bots with a role, model, memory and skills. One click to a private runtime — missions, integrations, and receipts on every run. Integrate this with your Claude Code, Codex, and let the agents manage your bots and then your work seamlessly.

records.name: BondStats Global Financial Clock
records.tagline: Visualize the 24-hour rhythm of global finance
records.description: See how institutional liquidity moves across Tokyo, Singapore, Hong Kong, London and New York in real time.

records.name: Preemie Age Calculator
records.tagline: Track true preemie milestones & print doctor reports
records.description: Tracking milestones using a premature baby's birth date causes false delay anxiety. RapidDocTools calculates true developmental age based on CDC & AAP pediatric guidelines. Includes interactive milestone checklists and printable doctor reports.

records.name: Othor AI 2.0
records.tagline: Your AI Head of Intelligence
records.description: BI assumes you have an analyst, a warehouse, and time. Leaders have none. Othor inverts it: connect a source, and agents start analyzing on their own. 10 new features, including Data Integration Agents (100+ sources, no migration), Analytical Agents, Decision Briefs, daily Big Picture reports, Document Intelligence, Chat with Data, Dashboards, and a Model Selector for your own LLMs. They compose - sources feed agents, agents feed briefs, briefs feed Big Picture. One pipeline, three altitudes.

records.name: EasySwitch
records.tagline: One mouse, keyboard and second screen for all your computers
records.description: Existing tools make you choose. Software KVMs (Synergy, Deskflow, Mouse Without Borders) share your mouse and keyboard but carry no video. Second-screen apps (Duet, spacedesk, Luna) turn a spare machine into a monitor but share no input. EasySwitch does both: slide your cursor across computers, type and paste anywhere, drag files, and extend your desktop onto the machine next to you. Encryption is free for everyone, not an upsell. Wayland works. Native Rust, no Electron - 19 MB of RAM idle.

records.name: Biblion Bible Study
records.tagline: A Bible reader with its own commentary and no tracking
records.description: Read the Bible in six public-domain translations, with the Hebrew and Greek alongside, Strong's lexicon, cross-references, hand-drawn maps and private notes. It also carries its own commentary on all sixty-six books — 3,031 comments, published nowhere else — and 327 hours of narration across four translations. No ad network, no third-party script, no tracking cookie, no account needed. The iPhone, Mac and Windows apps are bought once and work offline.

records.name: Volleyball Hitting Percentage calculator
records.tagline: Calculate Your Hitting. Track Your Progress.
records.description: The Volleyball Hitting Percentage Calculator helps players, coaches, and volleyball fans quickly calculate hitting efficiency. Enter the number of **kills, attack errors, and total attack attempts to get the hitting percentage. The calculator uses the standard formula: (Kills − Attack Errors) ÷ Total Attack Attempts. It also shows kill percentage, error percentage, and net kills, making it easier to understand a player's attacking performance.

records.name: ZynAssist: AI Assistant for Your Website
records.tagline: Let your website answer visitors 24/7
records.description: ZynAssist is an AI website chat assistant that automatically learns from your existing website content. Enter your URL, let ZynAssist build its knowledge base, then add the provided code to your website. It answers visitor questions, supports multiple languages, keeps information up to date, and helps businesses understand what their visitors are looking for through conversation insights.

records.name: Hidini
records.tagline: AI & Notes ovelay, hidden on screen sharing
records.description: A lightweight AI overlay for Mac that screen sharing can't see. Hit a hotkey to screenshot anything on your screen and get the answer back. Feed it your CV and a job posting and the answers match your background, not a textbook. Ask follow-ups in the chat layer. Set sticky notes only you can read. Transcribe an audio call as it happens. Zoom, Meet and Teams can't see any of it. Hidini also supports BYOK and local AI. Fast, built with Native Swift, under 4 MB. Free to try, no subscription!
